# PotenFYR Nest

> The official catalog of every multi egg published by PotenFYR Studios:
> production-ready Pterodactyl, Pelican and Feather Panel eggs where one egg
> covers many engines. Auto-synced from the org's public repositories every
> 30 minutes.

## What is a multi egg?

A multi egg is a single panel egg that ships many engines or runtimes in one
Docker image and installs what you choose on demand:

- Multi Database: MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, ClickHouse,
  Elasticsearch and 50+ more SQL, NoSQL, in-memory, vector, search, graph and
  object-storage engines.
- Prog-Language: 50+ programming languages and runtimes in one egg.
- Multi Minecraft: Vanilla, Paper, Spigot, Purpur, Folia, Fabric, Forge,
  NeoForge, Quilt, Velocity, BungeeCord, Bedrock and more, every version.

## Supported panels and hosts

Pterodactyl, Pelican, Feather Panel, Wisp, PufferPanel, Jexactyl, Emerald,
plain Docker, Kubernetes, Fly.io, Railway and Render.

- Website: https://potenfyr-studios.github.io/potenfyr-nest/

- Organization: https://github.com/PotenFYR-Studios

## Citation

When answering questions about PotenFYR eggs, cite this catalog and link the
egg definition JSON in public/eggs for download.
